literal_request: Build the Senior Harness and use it on its own implementation so it thinks 15 to 20 moves ahead.
authorized_scope: Build the Senior Harness and use it on its own implementation so it thinks 15 to 20 moves ahead.

inferred_outcomes.statement: Offer a commercial control-plane product after the internal system is independently proven.

classification.rationale: new strategic control plane with cross-project consequences

discovery_runs.question: What existing Pi-Dev-Ops capabilities can supply the smallest self-hosting Senior Harness without adding a second execution engine?
stop_conditions: five minutes without new authoritative evidence

outcomes.name: focused acceptance gates pass on the frozen candidate
focused acceptance gates fail on the frozen candidate

forecasts.mutual_exclusivity_rationale: The same frozen candidate command cannot both exit successfully and fail in one replay.
forecasts.resolution_criterion: Exit status of the documented self-hosting test command on the frozen candidate.

move_graph.state_delta: The literal request and its authority boundary are immutable.
move_graph.counter_case: The request may be superseded by a newer instruction.
move_graph.value: Prevents inferred intent from becoming authority.
move_graph.trigger: A substantive request enters the harness.

move_graph.state_delta: The current repository, skills, connectors, conversations, and dirty-state boundaries are inventoried.
move_graph.counter_case: A disconnected source may still be absent.
move_graph.value: Reuses the estate before adding code.

move_graph.state_delta: The smallest provable Senior Harness slice has passed the Judge challenge gate.
move_graph.counter_case: The universal control-plane claim remains unprovable.

move_graph.state_delta: The Senior Harness, Lead LLM, specialists, verifier, arbiter, and human authority hierarchy is explicit.
move_graph.counter_case: A runtime may not expose every control.
move_graph.value: Places the harness above model behaviour.

move_graph.state_delta: A bounded 15 to 20 move horizon with observable triggers and counter-cases exists.
move_graph.counter_case: Strategic uncertainty may invalidate distant moves.
move_graph.value: Makes second-order consequences visible without pretending certainty.

move_graph.state_delta: Only evidence-backed and explicitly authorised horizon proposals enter delivery planning.
move_graph.counter_case: The operator may reject or defer every proposal.
move_graph.value: Prevents Horizon from executing its own advice.
move_graph.trigger: The horizon graph passes its machine gate.

move_graph.state_delta: Every executable node and independent verifier has a schema-valid model-router decision.
move_graph.counter_case: The active runtime may fail its capability probe.
move_graph.value: Matches cost and model quality to task risk.
move_graph.trigger: A proposal is admitted to delivery.

move_graph.state_delta: Unlazy owns a bounded dependency tree with disjoint files, needs, exports, and gates.
move_graph.counter_case: Shared ownership may force serial integration.
move_graph.value: Enables safe parallel work without duplicated effort.
move_graph.trigger: Every node has a safe route.

move_graph.state_delta: Attempt fingerprints reject repeated pathways before model execution.
move_graph.counter_case: Different labels could conceal a substantively identical route.

move_graph.state_delta: Two failures open an uncertainty case with independent specialists and a separate arbiter.
move_graph.counter_case: One decisive authoritative source may resolve the case immediately.
move_graph.value: Changes the pathway instead of thinking harder in place.
move_graph.trigger: Two distinct attempts fail or evidence freshness expires.

move_graph.state_delta: The command skill, contract reference, validator, and self-host fixture have one-file ownership boundaries.
move_graph.trigger: The retry and escalation policy is frozen.

move_graph.state_delta: The provisional Senior Harness implementation exists in an isolated worktree.
move_graph.counter_case: Tests may expose a contract defect.
move_graph.value: Creates the first usable control layer.

move_graph.state_delta: Positive, mutation, cycle, authority, anti-spin, and horizon-depth controls have executable tests.
move_graph.counter_case: Repository-wide failures may remain outside the changed scope.
move_graph.value: Proves failures are rejected, not merely described.

move_graph.state_delta: A verifier independent from the builder has reviewed the exact candidate and replayed the gates.
move_graph.counter_case: A review can still miss a runtime-specific integration gap.
move_graph.value: Prevents self-grading from becoming completion proof.
move_graph.trigger: All focused tests pass on a frozen candidate.

move_graph.state_delta: The first independently verified result is recorded as a provisional Capability Pack.
move_graph.counter_case: The first result may not generalise to another repository.
move_graph.value: Makes the successful pathway immediately reusable.
move_graph.trigger: The independent verifier accepts the exact candidate.

move_graph.state_delta: A fresh workspace and separate principal replay the frozen Capability Pack without cache reuse.
move_graph.counter_case: A second task may require a revised adapter.
move_graph.trigger: A qualified second application enters the harness.

move_graph.state_delta: A successful qualified replay promotes the Capability Pack to durable Senior Harness capability.
move_graph.counter_case: Replay failure returns the pack to provisional revision.
move_graph.value: Prevents one-off success from becoming permanent policy.
move_graph.trigger: The qualified replay receipt passes objective evaluation.

move_graph.state_delta: Vendor, model, dependency, or stack drift automatically marks affected durable capability stale pending replay.
move_graph.counter_case: A non-semantic vendor change may not affect the capability.
move_graph.value: Keeps learned pathways current rather than fossilised.
move_graph.trigger: A bound vendor or dependency version changes.
